definitions.gloss: attendee; guest (at a ceremony such as a wedding or funeral)
definitions.explanation: A person present at a formal ceremony such as a wedding, funeral, or memorial. Used in formal contexts; the everyday word for a guest is {ゲスト} or {お{客|きゃく}さん}.

examples.japanese: {結婚式|けっこんしき}の{参列者|さんれつしゃ}は{百人|ひゃくにん}いた。
examples.english: There were a hundred guests at the wedding.

examples.japanese: {葬儀|そうぎ}の{参列者|さんれつしゃ}に{挨拶|あいさつ}をした。
examples.english: I greeted the attendees of the funeral.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}の{後|あと}、{新郎新婦|しんろうしんぷ}は{参列者|さんれつしゃ}{一人一人|ひとりひとり}にお{礼|れい}を{伝|つた}えた。
examples.english: After the ceremony, the bride and groom thanked each guest one by one.

notes:
Composed of {参列|さんれつ} (attendance at a ceremony) + 〜{者|しゃ} (person). Refers specifically to those attending a formal ceremony, not just any gathering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {結婚式|けっこんしき}の{参列者|さんれつしゃ}: wedding guests
- {葬儀|そうぎ}の{参列者|さんれつしゃ}: funeral attendees
- {参列者|さんれつしゃ}{名簿|めいぼ}: list of attendees
- {参列者|さんれつしゃ}{全員|ぜんいん}: all the attendees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出席者|しゅっせきしゃ}: attendee — broader; used for meetings, classes, conferences
- {来賓|らいひん}: invited guest of honor — VIPs at formal events
- {会葬者|かいそうしゃ}: funeral attendee — more specific to funerals only
